sourceMasters.title: Mining Earth and Stone Impact Primitives
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Contact origin must remain registered to the struck tile.

sourceMasters.title: Mining Metal Crystal and Volcanic Primitives
sourceMasters.consumer: DigSystem material feedback and tile destruction

sourceMasters.title: Hero Ability VFX Primitives

sourceMasters.title: Rewards and Discoveries

sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Reward hierarchy must preserve rarity and avoid visual inflation.

sourceMasters.title: Ambient and Weather Primitives
sourceMasters.layerBlend: weather depth 56-58 and ambient depth near 33
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Overdraw and collision-aligned particle bounds must remain capped.

sourceMasters.title: Reusable UI Chrome
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Nine-slice margins, content safe areas, and state geometry must be authored later.

sourceMasters.title: HUD and State Feedback
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: States need shape-coded accessibility and cannot rely on hue alone.

sourceMasters.title: Light Response Companions

sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Decorative art must never expand authoritative reveal radius.

sourceMasters.title: Graveborer and Cave Hazard Primitives
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Telegraphs must remain registered to collision footprint and timing.

sourceMasters.title: Underground Deep World Ambience
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Particles must remain sparse, pooled, capped, and FPS-gated.

sourceMasters.title: Cave Identity and Traversal
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Identity effects must not resemble hazards, pickups, or collision geometry.

sourceMasters.title: Animated Soil Mining
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Strike origin must remain tile-locked.

sourceMasters.title: Animated Common Metal Mining
sourceMasters.layerBlend: world FX depth 35-38, NORMAL plus restrained ADD

sourceMasters.title: Animated Precious and Volcanic Mining
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Molten alpha must not wash out terrain silhouettes.

sourceMasters.title: Unbreakable and Special Tile Feedback
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Reject cycles must never imply progressive damage.

sourceMasters.title: Thunder Strike Animation FX
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Escalation must follow authoritative timing and avoid strobe.

sourceMasters.title: Teleport and Powered Flight Transitions
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Teleport cancellation and reposition must be atomic.

sourceMasters.title: Heavy Punch Gem Power and Arc Core FX
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Charge, paid activation, failure, and damage resolution must differ.

sourceMasters.title: Player Locomotion Feedback
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Ground-contact effects must stay planted.

sourceMasters.title: Player Damage Depletion and Recovery
sourceMasters.consumer: Player hit feedback and HUD state bridge
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Feedback must remain accessible without color alone.

sourceMasters.title: Rain Collision Animation
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Particle bounds must stay collision-aligned and atlas-friendly.

sourceMasters.title: Snow Wind and Storm Animation
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Loops must not pop and lightning must avoid unsafe flashing.

sourceMasters.title: Cave Ambient Animation Loops
sourceMasters.primaryRisk: Loops must remain sparse, pooled, and FPS-gated.

sourceMasters.title: Earthquake Animation FX
